instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium close-up. In a minimalist studio with a light grey background, three women share a joyful embrace. The straight-haired woman (R1) on the left, wearing a white strap top, smiles happily at the camera. In the center, the freckled woman with an afro (R3) in a light blue top laughs warmly, her hand resting on R1's shoulder. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R2) in a dark strap top leans in close with a bright, cheerful smile. Soft, even studio lighting highlights their expressions, creating a warm, positive mood.
